rca_of_issue: Iteration-29 CRITICAL leak was in server.py:67 where get_current_user's users.find_one projected only {'_id':0}. Any endpoint that returned that dict (auth/me, and any user embed) leaked the argon2 hash. E1's fix added 'hashed_password': 0 to that projection AND to every other users.find_one that returns to clients (auth/signup, auth/login, auth/session, auth/apple, DELETE user lookups). Iteration-30 verified with 14 fresh assertions across the full surface plus the previously-failing test in test_email_auth.py — 30/30 backend pass, no leak found on any user-returning endpoint.
